item.title: CFR Welcomes Lily Bosecker
item.description: Christian Family Radio is excited to welcome Lily Bosecker as our new Partnership Development Coordinator! A WKU grad with a heart for ministry, Lily steps into the role as Stephanie Matthews retires after years of faithful service. Join us in celebrating this new season and welcoming Lily to the CFR family.
